cwe_content.cwe: CWE-90,Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')

candidate.Reason: Direct string concatenation of user input (token.getUsername()) into LDAP search filter without proper escaping for LDAP special characters. This allows LDAP injection attacks where an attacker can manipulate the filter structure.

Direct string concatenation of user-controlled input (userDN) into LDAP search filter without proper LDAP escaping. UserDN may contain special characters that can be used to manipulate the LDAP query structure.
